goldenTest.noProjectName: pubspec.yaml in {projectPath} has no name: line, so the widget import cannot be written. Nothing was written.

project.noPubspec: No pubspec.yaml in {projectPath}. Run this in a Flutter project (flutter create), or pass projectPath. Nothing was requested or written.
project.pathRequiredOverHttp: projectPath is required over HTTP: the server's working folder is not the client's project. Pass the Flutter project's path on the machine that runs this server. Nothing was requested or written.

screenshot.renderFailed: Figma could not render node {nodeId}: rendering of that specific node has failed.
screenshot.boundsNote: After the image comes a text block with nodeId, format, scale, useAbsoluteBounds, the node's absoluteBoundingBox and absoluteRenderBounds from Figma, and imageWidth and imageHeight read from the image itself (png and jpg only; an svg or pdf file has no pixel size). The image covers the absoluteBoundingBox when useAbsoluteBounds is true, and the absoluteRenderBounds when it is not. boundsError says why the boxes are missing when the node could not be read; the image is still returned.

budget.cutNote: A reply over the size limit keeps the first nodes in document order and sets truncated: true; omittedNodeIds lists the ones left out, and when that list is itself too long it is cut off and omittedNodeCount (omittedVariableCount for variables) gives the true number left out.

variables.planLimited: {message}. This API is available to full members of Enterprise orgs.
